'''Ryan Morris''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 69 FL from Santa Barbara, Ca. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 23 (20 August 1999) interviewed him on Young Jedi decks. ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #43 printed his [[The Thrill of Victory (Star Wars Insider)|The Thrill of Victory]] on the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="insider-1998">Ryan Morris, "The Thrill of Victory", ''Star Wars Insider'' #43, pp. 64–65. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/starwarsinsider_1_to_153_plus_specials Star Wars Insider Magazines (1 to 153 + Specials)], Internet Archive.</ref><ref name="wook-43">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_43 Star Wars Insider 43], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200809061703/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_43 Internet Archive]</ref>
